transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because things with my in-laws have gotten serious. It’s not just family arguing anymore. I know they’ve been using the altar and the parish committee to push me out, to make people forget everything I’ve done for this family. I need someone to understand what’s happening.
Can you tell me more about what you mean when you say your in-laws are trying to push you out and make people forget what you’ve done for the family?

I mean they’re not just disagreeing with me. They’re using the church, the altar, and people on the parish committee to turn everyone against me. It feels like they’re trying to erase what I’ve done for this family, like they want people to forget my part completely and push me aside.
Can you tell me more about how you know your in-laws are using the church and parish committee against you? Have you noticed any specific behaviors or events that make you believe this is happening?

I know because it isn’t just regular family talk anymore. They bring things into the church, around the altar and the parish committee, like they’re trying to make people see me a certain way. It feels planned, like they want me pushed out and they want everyone to forget what I’ve done for the family.

Can you explain how exactly your in-laws are using the altar and parish committee against you? Are you saying they’re spreading false information about you, or is it more of a feeling that they’re trying to change how people see you?

It’s more than just a feeling to me. I came in because I know my in-laws aren’t just arguing with me anymore. They’re using the altar and the parish committee to push me out, to make people forget what I’ve done for this family. I can see they’re trying to change how people see me.
Do you feel your in-laws are intentionally trying to harm your reputation with a specific plan, or does it seem more like they're just upset with you and expressing it through the church?

No, it feels intentional. I don’t think they’re just upset and talking through the church. I came in because I knew they were using the altar and the parish committee to push me out, and to make people forget what I’ve done for this family. That’s what it feels like they’re doing, like there’s a plan behind it.
Can you tell me if you believe specific people in the parish committee or church are involved in this plan, or if it’s more of a general feeling that the group as a whole is against you?

I think it’s my in-laws behind it, mostly. But they’re using the parish committee and the altar, so it feels like the whole church side of things is being pulled into it. I can’t name every person, but I know they’re trying to push me out and make everyone forget what I’ve done for this family.

Can you tell me if you believe your in-laws have specifically coordinated with certain people in the parish committee, or if it’s more of a general sense that the group is being used against you without knowing exactly who is involved?

I can’t say I know every person who’s involved or that I saw them all sit down together. But I do believe my in-laws are behind it. They’re using the parish committee and the altar to push me out, to make people stop seeing what I’ve done for this family. It doesn’t feel random to me.
Can you tell me if you believe your in-laws have taken any specific actions using the church or the parish committee, such as spreading rumors or making false accusations, to harm your reputation?

I can’t point to one exact rumor I heard word for word, but yes, I believe they’re doing things through the church. Using the altar, using the parish committee, making it seem like I don’t belong there or like what I’ve done for this family doesn’t matter. It feels like they’re trying to push me out and turn people against me.
